summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund S filed a Form 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned financing subsidiary, GPIF S Funding, entered into a first amendment to its amended and restated revolving credit and security agreement with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent and sole lender, and Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as collateral custodian. The amendment, effective September 30, 2026, temporarily modifies the facility's Aggregate Commitments from September 30, 2026 through August 16, 2027, or an earlier date agreed among the administrative agent, required lenders and Funding. No pricing, stake, premium or change-of-control terms were disclosed. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for any renewed facility terms or borrowing-base changes.
